notes: Printed: 'As this artifact enters, choose a creature type. Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1. {3}, {T}: Look at the top three cards of your library. You may reveal a creature card of the chosen type from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.' The Icon enters choosing Elf (the quality ask's word, CR 614.12a). Seat 0's Elf Scout gets +1/+1; its Goblin and seat 1's Elf do not (a creature you control of the chosen type). The activation looks at the top three, top first: a Forest, a Library Elf and a Library Goblin; the Library Elf is the one creature card of the chosen type, revealed into the hand, and the Forest and the Goblin go to the bottom in a random order. On the base (dafdd5ff) the card's choice and its reads did not compile (a needs-atom record): no ask offers the word Elf, nothing gets +1/+1 and the look puts nothing into the hand.
